whoosh.desc: Airy whoosh for transitions and title entrances

whoosh-fast.desc: Short, quick swoosh for snappy cuts

swipe.desc: Downward swipe, good for slides/cards leaving

pop.desc: Bubbly pop for captions, stickers and cards appearing

bubble.desc: Rising bubble blip for playful pop-ups

mouse-click.desc: Mouse click (down/up) for UI and cursor moments

typing.desc: Keyboard typing burst for typed text / prompts

ding.desc: Bright bell ding for a key point or correct answer

notification.desc: Phone notification chime for DM / alert moments

riser.desc: Tension riser that builds into a reveal

bass-drop.desc: Deep bass drop for dramatic reveals

shutter.desc: Camera shutter for freeze-frames and photos

glitch.desc: Digital glitch burst to pair with the glitch effect

tick-tock.desc: Clock tick-tock for countdowns / time pressure

cash.desc: Cash-register style ka-ching for money moments

sparkle.desc: Magic sparkle shimmer for reveals and 'aha' moments

zoom.desc: Mechanical zoom sound to pair with punch-in zooms
